desc: Remake this sea dragon pet as a classic 16-bit indie pixel game sprite, not a flashy cartoon. Small simple dot eyes with one 1px highlight. Clean pixel outline in dark navy tones, not pure black. Calm muted colors, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters and dithering. Cute chibi about 2 heads tall, short body and limbs. Keep the sitting pose and wings; simplify the spiky crest to a few clean spikes.
